name: 05461 · Hinesburg, VT
findings: ZIP 05461 (Hinesburg) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 05461 (Hinesburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 05461 (Hinesburg) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
